<json>{
  "states": [
    "ConnectionEstablished",
    "AwaitingClientCommand",
    "AwaitingCommandContinuation",
    "ProcessingCommand"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "ConnectionEstablished",
      "event": "receive server greeting",
      "action": "send untagged response",
      "to": "AwaitingClientCommand"
    },
    {
      "from": "AwaitingClientCommand",
      "event": "receive client command",
      "action": "parse command and arguments",
      "to": "ProcessingCommand"
    },
    {
      "from": "ProcessingCommand",
      "event": "cond continuation required",
      "action": "send command continuation request",
      "to": "AwaitingCommandContinuation"
    },
    {
      "from": "AwaitingCommandContinuation",
      "event": "receive command continuation",
      "action": "collect remaining octets",
      "to": "ProcessingCommand"
    },
    {
      "from": "ProcessingCommand",
      "event": "cond command complete",
      "action": "send tagged completion response",
      "to": "AwaitingClientCommand"
    },
    {
      "from": "AwaitingClientCommand",
      "event": "receive untagged data",
      "action": "cache server data",
      "to": "AwaitingClientCommand"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": [
    "NotAuthenticated",
    "Authenticated",
    "Selected",
    "Logout"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "ConnectionEstablished",
      "event": "receive OK greeting",
      "action": "enter state",
      "to": "NotAuthenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "ConnectionEstablished",
      "event": "receive PREAUTH greeting",
      "action": "enter state",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "ConnectionEstablished",
      "event": "receive BYE greeting",
      "action": "enter state",
      "to": "Logout"
    },
    {
      "from": "NotAuthenticated",
      "event": "receive LOGIN or AUTHENTICATE",
      "action": "reply OK",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "NotAuthenticated",
      "event": "receive LOGOUT",
      "action": "send BYE and OK",
      "to": "Logout"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive SELECT or EXAMINE",
      "action": "reply OK",
      "to": "Selected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive CLOSE or UNSELECT",
      "action": "reply OK",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "cond failed SELECT or EXAMINE",
      "action": "reply NO or BAD",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive LOGOUT",
      "action": "send BYE and OK",
      "to": "Logout"
    },
    {
      "from": "Selected",
      "event": "receive CLOSE or UNSELECT",
      "action": "reply OK",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "Selected",
      "event": "cond unsolicited CLOSED response",
      "action": "send CLOSED",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "Selected",
      "event": "receive LOGOUT",
      "action": "send BYE and OK",
      "to": "Logout"
    },
    {
      "from": "NotAuthenticated",
      "event": "cond server shutdown or connection closed",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "Logout"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "cond server shutdown or connection closed",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "Logout"
    },
    {
      "from": "Selected",
      "event": "cond server shutdown or connection closed",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "Logout"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": [
    "NoCommandInProgress",
    "CommandInProgress",
    "WaitingForContinuation",
    "Authenticated"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "NoCommandInProgress",
      "event": "receive COMMAND",
      "action": "process command",
      "to": "CommandInProgress"
    },
    {
      "from": "CommandInProgress",
      "event": "cond continuation_required",
      "action": "send continuation_request",
      "to": "WaitingForContinuation"
    },
    {
      "from": "WaitingForContinuation",
      "event": "receive continuation_data",
      "action": "process data",
      "to": "CommandInProgress"
    },
    {
      "from": "CommandInProgress",
      "event": "cond command_complete",
      "action": "send completion_response",
      "to": "NoCommandInProgress"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "timeout 30min_no_activity",
      "action": "close session",
      "to": "NoCommandInProgress"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive COMMAND",
      "action": "reset autologout_timer",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": [
    "ConnectionEstablished",
    "Authenticated",
    "SelectedMailbox",

  ],
  "transitions": [

      "from": "ConnectionEstablished",

      "to": "Authenticated"

      "from": "ConnectionEstablished",

      "action": "reply OK or NO",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },

      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive SELECT or EXAMINE",
      "action": "reply OK and FLAGS EXISTS",
      "to": "SelectedMailbox"
    },

      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive command with literal",
      "action": "send continuation request",
      "to": "CommandContinuation"

      "event": "receive literal data",
      "action": "process command",
      "to": "Authenticated"

      "action": "send EXISTS response",
      "to": "SelectedMailbox"

      "action": "send EXPUNGE response",
      "to": "SelectedMailbox"

      "action": "reply CLOSED and OK",
      "to": "SelectedMailbox"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive LOGOUT",
      "action": "send BYE response",
      "to": "ConnectionEstablished"
    }
  ]
}</json>

<json>{
  "states": [
    "Unauthenticated",
    "TLSNegotiation",
    "Authenticated",
    "SelectedMailbox",
    "LoggingOut"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Unauthenticated",
      "event": "receive STARTTLS",
      "action": "reply OK Proceed with TLS",
      "to": "TLSNegotiation"
    },
    {
      "from": "TLSNegotiation",
      "event": "receive AUTHENTICATE SCRAM-SHA-256",
      "action": "send challenge and verify response",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive ENABLE IMAP4rev2",
      "action": "reply ENABLED IMAP4rev2",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive SELECT INBOX",
      "action": "reply EXISTS FLAGS UIDVALIDITY LIST OK",
      "to": "SelectedMailbox"
    },
    {
      "from": "SelectedMailbox",
      "event": "receive FETCH 12 FULL",
      "action": "send message metadata and envelope",
      "to": "SelectedMailbox"
    },
    {
      "from": "SelectedMailbox",
      "event": "receive FETCH 12 BODY[HEADER]",
      "action": "send message headers",
      "to": "SelectedMailbox"
    },
    {
      "from": "SelectedMailbox",
      "event": "receive STORE 12 +FLAGS \\DELETED",
      "action": "update flags and reply FETCH",
      "to": "SelectedMailbox"
    },
    {
      "from": "SelectedMailbox",
      "event": "receive LOGOUT",
      "action": "send BYE and OK LOGOUT",
      "to": "LoggingOut"
    }
  ]
}</json>
